title: 第8章
content_zh: 至尊狂妻冷若雪走进密室，先抬头看看了环境，密室非常宽敞明亮，偌大的夜明珠高高的悬挂在墙上，中间靠墙的位置放了一张灵玉床，床上放了一个蒲团，还有一张精致的檀木床桌，床的左侧摆放了一个书架，上面摆满了书，大多是与修炼有关的，密室的四个角落各有一个石柱子，上面镶满了各色的灵晶，用来聚灵，听爷爷说这间密室是冷家的一位祖先建造的，这里面灵气浓郁至少是外面的2倍以上，这样一间规格的密室即使在那些个顶级势力中也是数一数二的。冷若雪盘膝坐在灵玉床上，灵玉同样有聚灵的功效，所以她刚一坐在床上就感觉到了灵气的充沛，不过她并没有打算立即开始吸收灵气，反而先看起了书，然后又拿出了爷爷给她的灵技，修炼起来。灵力属性分为火、风、水、地、木、光、暗七种，每一种属性的灵力都有专属的灵技，灵技的等级分为初级、中级、高级、天级，其中修灵者可以修炼初级灵技，修灵师、大灵师可以修炼中级灵技，只有达到灵王等级以上才能够修炼高级以上灵技，而若是想要修炼某一属性的高级灵技，则必须修炼完这一灵技的初级和中级之后，才能够修炼高级的，除此之外修炼灵技还要根据自身等级，循序渐进，由低级到高级逐一修炼，不可越级。对于灵师来说，灵技的重要性是不言而喻的，不过初级灵技并不难学到，如果家里有人觉醒了灵师，只要去一趟灵师公会，就可以免费得到初级灵技，若想学中级灵技，可以自己花钱购买，也可以去学院学习，但是若是想学到高级灵技最好的方式就是去学院学习，市面上是很少能买得到的，即使有，也未必是适合自己属性的，至于天级灵技，恐怕就只有各顶级势力家族或者灵师强者手中才会拥有，绝对的有价无市。而爷爷给她的灵技中，每一系的初、中级灵技都有，而火系和风系中还包含了高级灵技和天级灵技，由此可见，冷家的底蕴是非常深厚的。冷若雪将所有的初级灵技都修炼完，便着手修炼中级灵技，在修炼累了的时候就看看书，然后其余的时间用来冥想，吸收灵力。在所有初、中级灵技中冷若雪最喜欢的就是火系的爆炎术，木系的束缚术，他们虽然都只是中级灵技，不过在战斗中的作用是非常大的，爆炎术是一种攻击灵技，束缚术则属于辅助性灵技，若是在加上风系的疾风术，这三种灵技如果在战斗中配合使用的话，那就是在欺负人，不过，恐怕也就只有她会这么想，因为可不是每个人都和她一样是全系的灵力属性的，而且木系属性的灵力是非常少见的，所以想要这三种配合使用可能性实在是太小了。冷擎天坐在密室不远处的石凳上，面前的石桌上面摆满了食物，他一边吃着美食，一边喝着茶水，眼睛却是在盯着一动不动地趴在密室门口的小兽身上，自己的宝贝孙女给自己交待了任务，所以他得保护好这个和自己孙女生命相关的小东西，他可不想因为自己的疏忽，而让自己的孙女有任何的危险，所以，他可是不敢让这小东西离开自己的视线的，不过他有一点怎么也想不明白，既然自己的孙女怕这小兽有危险，而这小兽又不肯离开雪儿太远，那怎么不进灵兽空间呢？不会是这两小白不知道有灵兽空间这回事吧，越想他越觉得有这个可能哦，冷擎天忍不住胡乱猜测着。其实在冷若雪闭关前是想让宝宝进灵兽空间的，可是宝宝说死也不肯，还说自己不是灵兽，才不要呆在那里面，它要在外面保护姐姐，冷若雪拗不过它，只好把它交给爷爷照顾了。“宝宝，宝宝。”冷擎天走到小兽身边叫着它的名字。趴在地上的宝宝连眼皮都没抬，大尾巴更是把自己的小身子捂得严严实实的。“……”这叫宝宝的小兽根本不鸟他，冷擎天不由得有些尴尬，都10多天了，每天他都给这小东西喂食，这小东西怎么就这么没良心呢？“老爷，刘公公来了。”管家的通报，打断了冷擎天的自怨自艾。“来的真不是时候。”冷擎天有些不悦道。“你们在这守好了，不许任何人接近这里。”吩咐好属下后，冷擎天慢吞吞地朝着客厅方向走去。“大将军。”皇帝身边的太监总管刘公公，看到冷擎天连忙站起来弯身行礼，虽然他是皇帝身边的红人，可是他最不敢得罪的就是这冷大将军，惹恼了他，皇帝也保不住他。“刘公公不必多礼，快请坐。”冷擎天客套的道。“刘公公是来给我送赔偿的吗？”冷擎天笑眯眯的道，10多天了，估计也差不多凑齐了吧！刘公公拿出一个储物戒指递给冷擎天：“大将军要求的赔偿都在里面了，请大将军清点下，奴才也好回去交差。”冷擎天也不客气，直接把那戒指里的东西移到自己的储物戒指中，一样一样地清点着。“没有问题。”清点完，冷擎天道。“冷大将军，请接旨吧！”刘公公突然道，然后也不宣读，直接双手把圣旨递到冷擎天的手中，转身就打算离开。“刘公公，圣旨你还没宣读呢，怎么就要走了？”冷擎天看到刘公公打算开溜了，连忙道，虽然他不知道这圣旨上写的是什么，不过准没好事。“大将军，陛下说了，圣旨您自阅就可以了，陛下还等着奴才回宫复命呢，奴才先告退了。”说完，连忙骑着自己的飞行灵兽跑掉了。冷擎天打开圣旨，然后又生气地把圣旨丢到一边，哼！想得到美，皇帝这是打算把他硬拉到七皇子这边啊，因为那又是一张赐婚的旨意，他退了七皇子的婚事，皇上又把雪儿赐婚给了七皇子姨母家的庶出二少爷，一个体弱多病的药罐子，而且怕他当场拒婚，居然连圣旨都不敢宣读，其实不宣读更好，他完全可以当做没看到，料想皇帝也不能把他怎么样。密室内。冷若雪盘膝坐在灵玉床上，吸收着浓郁的灵气，经过了这段时间不停地吸收，身体的灵力异常充沛，通过内视，她看到自己体内的灵力光球越来越大，而且开始旋转，她不禁加快了吸收灵力的速度，四面八方的灵力不断地朝着她的身体涌来，随着体内灵力的越来越多，她慢慢的感觉到灵力似乎饱合了，若想继续吸收，就只有突破那层阻碍她吸收灵力的壁障，想到这，她觉得突破的时机到了，于是便将身体内的全部灵力汇集到一起，一鼓作气集中地朝着壁障发起攻击，一下，两下……终于，似乎听到‘彭’的一声，随即天地规则降临，她知道她已经晋阶成灵王了。“小姐晋阶了！”密室外，绿桃和翠竹开心地道，她们在看到天地规则降临的时候，就知道小姐已经成功突破了，因为在大灵师之前都是没有天地规则降临的，只有晋阶为灵王之后，才能够享受到这样的待遇，天地规则的降临对于晋阶者本人是有着莫大的好处的，它可以拓宽身体筋脉，这是上天对于晋阶者的赏赐，而且在天地规则降临的时候吸收的灵力越多，对于日后修炼越有好处。“咦，宝宝怎么一点变化都没有？”
content_en: The Supreme Crazy Wife Leng Ruoxue walked into the secret room and first looked up at the environment. The secret room was very spacious and bright. A huge night pearl was hung high on the wall. There was a jade bed in the middle against the wall. There was a futon on the bed and an exquisite sandalwood bed table. There was a bookshelf on the left side of the bed, which was filled with books, mostly books. Related to cultivation, there are stone pillars in each of the four corners of the secret room, which are inlaid with various kinds of spiritual crystals for gathering spirits. I heard from grandpa that this secret room was built by an ancestor of the Leng family. The spiritual energy inside is at least twice as rich as outside. A secret room of this size is one of the best even among the top powers. Leng Ruoxue sat cross-legged on the spiritual jade bed. Ling jade also has the effect of gathering spirits, so she felt the abundance of spiritual energy as soon as she sat on the bed. However, she did not plan to start absorbing spiritual energy immediately. Instead, she read a book first, and then took out the spiritual skills her grandfather gave her and started practicing. Spiritual power attributes are divided into seven types: fire, wind, water, earth, wood, light, and dark. Each attribute of spiritual power has its own spiritual skills. The levels of spiritual skills are divided into elementary, intermediate, advanced, and heavenly levels. Among them, spiritual practitioners can practice elementary spiritual skills, and spiritual masters and great spiritual masters can practice intermediate spiritual skills. Only those who have reached the level of the Spirit King or above Only those who are advanced can practice advanced spiritual skills and above. If you want to practice advanced spiritual skills of a certain attribute, you must complete the elementary and intermediate levels of this spiritual skill before you can practice advanced ones. In addition, you must practice spiritual skills step by step according to your own level, from low-level to high-level, and do not skip levels. For spiritual masters, the importance of spiritual skills is self-evident, but primary spiritual skills are not difficult to learn. If someone in your family has awakened a spiritual master, you can get primary spiritual skills for free by going to the spiritual masters guild. If you want to learn intermediate spiritual skills, you can buy them yourself or go to an academy to learn them. But if you want to learn advanced spiritual skills, the best way is to go to an academy to learn them. They are rarely available on the market, and even if they are, they may not be suitable for your attributes. As for heaven-level spiritual skills, they are probably only available to the top power families or powerful spiritual masters. They are absolutely priceless but not marketable. Among the spiritual skills that her grandfather gave her, there are elementary and intermediate spiritual skills in each department, and the fire and wind systems also include advanced spiritual skills and heaven-level spiritual skills. This shows that the Leng family has a very deep foundation. After Leng Ruoxue finished practicing all the elementary spiritual skills, she started to practice the intermediate spiritual skills. When she was tired from practicing, she would read a book, and then spend the rest of the time meditating and absorbing spiritual power. Among all the primary and intermediate spiritual skills, Leng Ruoxue's favorites are the fire-type explosive technique and the wood-type binding technique. Although they are only intermediate spiritual techniques, they are very useful in combat. The explosive technique is an offensive spiritual technique, and the binding technique is an auxiliary spiritual technique. If you add the wind-type blast technique, these three If spiritual skills are used together in battle, it will be bullying. However, I am afraid that she is the only one who thinks so, because not everyone has all the spiritual attributes like her, and spiritual powers with wood attributes are very rare, so the possibility of using these three together is really slim. Leng Qingtian sat on a stone bench not far from the secret room. The stone table in front of him was filled with food. While he was eating delicious food and drinking tea, his eyes were staring at the little beast lying motionless at the door of the secret room. His precious granddaughter had given him a task, so he had to protect this little thing that was related to his granddaughter's life. west, he didn't want to put his granddaughter in any danger because of his negligence, so he didn't dare to let this little thing leave his sight, but there was one thing he couldn't figure out. Since his granddaughter was afraid that this little beast was in danger, and this little beast refused to leave Xue'er too far, why didn't it enter the spirit beast space? It couldn't be that these two novices didn't know about the existence of spirit beast space. The more he thought about it, the more he thought it was possible. Leng Qingtian couldn't help but make random guesses. In fact, before Leng Ruoxue went into seclusion, she wanted the baby to enter the spirit beast space, but the baby refused even to death. She also said that she was not a spirit beast, so she should not stay there. It wanted to protect her sister outside. Leng Ruoxue couldn't resist it, so she had to give it to her grandfather to take care of. "Baby, baby." Leng Qingtian walked to the little beast and called its name. The baby lying on the ground didn't even raise his eyelids, and his big tail covered his little body tightly. "..." This little beast called Baobao didn't care about him at all. Leng Qingtian couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed. He had been feeding this little thing every day for more than 10 days. Why was this little thing so heartless? "Master, Eunuch Liu is here." The butler's announcement interrupted Leng Qingtian's self-pity. "It's really not the right time." Leng Qingtian said with some displeasure. "You guys stay here and don't allow anyone to approach here." After giving instructions to his subordinates, Leng Qingtian walked slowly towards the living room. "General." Eunuch Liu, the chief eunuch beside the emperor, quickly stood up and bowed when he saw Leng Qingtian. Although he was a popular person beside the emperor, the one he dared not offend was General Leng. If he pissed him off, the emperor would not be able to protect him. "Eunuch Liu, there's no need to be polite, please take a seat." Leng Qingtian said politely. "Eunuch Liu is here to give me compensation?" Leng Qingtian said with a smile. It has been more than 10 days, and I guess it has almost been collected! Eunuch Liu took out a storage ring and handed it to Leng Qingtian: "The compensation requested by the general is all in it. Please check it out, so that I can go back and deliver the goods." Leng Qingtian was not polite and directly moved the contents of the ring to his own storage ring and counted them one by one. "No problem." After counting, Leng Qingtian said. "General Leng, please accept the order!" Eunuch Liu suddenly said, and then without reading it out, he directly held the Holy Spirit with both hands.
